newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Maurice River, N.J..

text.p: The Board of Education of the Township of Maurice River

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the undersigned for The Board of Education of the Township of Maurice River, in the County of Cumberland, New Jersey (School District'') at the School District's Administrative Offices, South Delsea Drive, Drawer D, Port Elizabeth, New Jersey 08348, until 11:00 A.M., on
at which time they will be publicly opened and announced for the purchase of the referenced bonds, due on January 1 (Bonds''), as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
The Bonds will be dated January 1, 1997 and bear interest at the rate per annum specified by the successful bidder therefor, payable on July 1, 1997 and semiannually

thereafter on January 1 and July 1 in each year until maturity or earlier redemption. The Bonds will be subject to redemption prior to maturity on the terms and conditions set forth in the Preliminary Official Statement hereinafter mentioned. Upon initial issuance, the Bonds will be issued in Book- entry-only form and registered in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC''). Individual purchases may be made in the principal amount of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof through book entries made on the books and records of DTC and its participants. The Bonds will be subject to the approving legal opinion of Parker, McCay & Criscuolo, Marlton, New Jersey, Bond Counsel to the School District. Copies of the full Notice of Sale and Official Form of Proposal and Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained by contacting Ann Timmons, Business Administrator/Board Secretary, at the School District's Administrative Offices, South Delsea Drive, Drawer D, Port Elizabeth, New Jersey 08348. The School District's telephone number is (609) 825- 6921.
